items.title: [O'Connor] The Blazers are betting on a Ja Morant comeback. Portland acquired a player who once looked like a future face of the NBA for Jerami Grant and Kris Murray: that's how far his value has fallen. Maybe Ja still has a few prime seasons left in him. Or maybe he will shoot Portland in the foot.
items.author: PianoJealous307
